items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: I heard of Paul Barnes, but I never did know him until he came into this band.

ctx.x: No more. What about Paul Barnes? Well, Paul Barnes, you see, I heard of Paul Barnes, but I never did know him until he came into this band. And Paul Barnes is a nice musician, fine musician. He really is. But he's getting used to the band now.
And he's never played the E flat before?
